summary: Draft updated at submission.json (validated read-only: valid, no diagnostics) with the harness assurance_generated_test.go; scratch removed. This turn opens a new A2 line and requests its experiment: a leader that loses membership through an applied configuration change while Config.StepDownOnRemoval is false. Source trace: switchToConfig (raft.go:1975-2030) keeps the leadership role when the node is absent from the new configuration and step-down was not requested, stepLeader then drops every proposal because r.trk.Progress[r.id] is nil (raft.go:1290-1295), and tickHeartbeat keeps broadcasting heartbeats (raft.go:862-889, 692-707) that reset every remaining voter's election timer. The experiment drives real producers in one process: propose and replicate a ConfChangeV2 removing node 1, apply the committed entry on all nodes with the documented type-based loop plus applied-index advance, then run a fixed 80-round window ticking every node once per round with prompt delivery, and finally probe the read path on the ineligible leader with one and then a quorum of acknowledgments. Two comparisons encode the duty that a cluster whose configuration no longer contains its leader must still be able to elect one: StepDownOnRemoval=false (expected violated) and StepDownOnRemoval=true as the control over identical sampling. Construction-time local runs show, for the record and not as formal evidence, the contrast the experiment is built to measure - with step-down disabled the removed leader stays StateLeader, no new leader appears and last index/committed never move while both followers stay followers with election timers reset, whereas with step-down enabled the node becomes a follower immediately after applying the change and node 3 becomes leader inside the same window; the read path still answers, but only after a quorum of the current configuration acknowledges, never from the ineligible leader's own vote alone. Limitations and the synthetic tick schedule are registered with the question, and the formal conclusion awaits the controller's retained receipt.
